name: Abstract Test Suite
abstract: Annex A (normative) of OGC API — Processes — Part 1: Core (DRAFT, OGC 18-062r3): introduction and layout of the conformance classes and abstract tests.
description:
# Introduction OGC Web Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) are not Web Services in the traditional sense. Rather, they define the behavior and content of a set of Resources exposed through a Web API implementation instance. Therefore, an API endpoint may expose resources in addition to those defined by the standard. A test engine must be able to traverse the API definition, identify and validate test points, and ignore resource paths which are not to be tested. The following requirement applies for a server implementing the OGC API — Processes — Part 1: Core under test: # Conformance Class Core # Testable process # Retrieve the API landing page **NOTE:** The landing page may be retrieved in one of two formats. Verify that an OpenAPI definition in JSON is available using the media type `application/vnd.oai.openapi+json;version=x.y` (were `x.y` is the version of the OpenAPI specification used) and link relation `service-desc` 2. Verify that an HTML version of the API definition is available using the media type `text/html` and link relation `service-doc`. **Example 4** **identifier** /conf/oas/implementation **target** /req/oas/implementation **test-purpose** Verify that all capabilities specified in the OpenAPI definition are implemented by the API. **test-method** 1. Construct a path from each URL template including all server URL options and all enumerated path parameters. 2. For each path defined in the OpenAPI document, validate that the path performs in accordance with the API definition and the API-Features standard. **Example 5** **identifier** /conf/oas/security **target** /req/oas/security **test-purpose** Verify that any authentication protocols implemented by the API are documented in the OpenAPI document. **test-method** 1. Identify all authentication protocols supported by the API. 2. Validate that each authentication protocol is described in the OpenAPI document by a Security Schema Object and its use is specified by a Security Requirement Object. ## Conformance Class OpenAPI 3.0 ## Conformance Class OpenAPI 3.1 # Conformance Class Job list **NOTE 1:** An implementation of the Processes API can define different values for “minimum”, “maximum” and “default”. **NOTE 2:** A job list may be retrieved in one of two formats.
